name: g2_scsi_arcturus_vega
label: SCSI (three 61 cm Dobsonians, New Haven): Arcturus and Vega at 532 nm on the 2-3 m north-south pair
notes: The six 2025 Arcturus separations of the paper's Table 2, one full night each: an upper bound on what SCSI collected (7.77 h in total over seven nights, at 0.27-1.33 Mcps).
Paper values to compare with: Arcturus |V|^2 = 0.49 +/- 0.26 near 20 cycles/arcsec, theta_LD = 21.5 +/- 1.8 mas with the speckle data; Vega 4.7 sigma in 11.87 h.
Arcturus uses the one-off NewEra model (resource newera_arcturus); Vega interpolates in the A-star tables (resource newera). --no-newera falls back to blackbodies.
